import numpy as np
from tslearn.metrics import compute_mask

# compute_mask is a helper function in tslearn.metrics.dtw_variants
# It takes a mask array (or None) and returns a boolean mask array of shape (sz1, sz2)
# If mask is None, it returns an array of zeros (meaning no mask, all valid).
# Let's test it with a mask array and with None.

sz1, sz2 = 5, 5
mask_none = compute_mask(None, sz1, sz2)
mask_zeros = compute_mask(np.zeros((sz1, sz2)), sz1, sz2)

assert mask_none.shape == (sz1, sz2), f"Expected shape {(sz1, sz2)}, got {mask_none.shape}"
assert np.all(mask_none == 0), "Expected all zeros when mask is None"
assert mask_zeros.shape == (sz1, sz2), f"Expected shape {(sz1, sz2)}, got {mask_zeros.shape}"
assert np.all(mask_zeros == 0), "Expected all zeros when mask is zeros"

print(f"__CHECK__ compute_mask {mask_none.sum()}")
